sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)

notes: Figures of ingested previous-year questions, to be recreated as diagrams through visual-director (never scanned). Each brief describes the official figure; labels are placed at anchors once an image exists.

requests.brief: a skeletal structural formula of benzanilide on white, thin dark lines: a benzene ring on the lower left bonded to a carbonyl carbon with a double-bonded oxygen pointing up; the carbonyl carbon bonded to a nitrogen; the nitrogen carries a hydrogen pointing down and is bonded to a second benzene ring on the upper right; no letters drawn. Recreate the figure of NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper, 2 April Shift 1, question 66 faithfully (same parts, positions and directions); every letter, number, sign and arrow label is added by the app at label anchors.
must_show: N bonded to a second benzene ring
must_not_show: a scan or copy of the original paper

alt.en: Benzanilide, PhCONHPh. Positions marked: on the benzoyl ring, p is ortho and r is meta to the carbonyl group; on the N-phenyl ring, s is ortho and u is para to the nitrogen.
alt.hi: बेन्ज़ऐनिलाइड, PhCONHPh। चिह्नित स्थान: बेन्ज़ॉयल वलय पर p, कार्बोनिल समूह के ऑर्थो और r मेटा है; N-फ़ेनिल वलय पर s, नाइट्रोजन के ऑर्थो और u पैरा है।
